> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Answers to the review summary on this PR, by finding:

- **YouTube's Ready badge vs. the detail pane:** obsolete. #458 computes the badge from the preset the row would make, `pages/export/export-page.tsx:338` at the top of the stack. See the inline thread.
- **"Only when the copy fits" test:** obsolete. #458/#467 replaced the test and the subtitle with size-bar tests that cover both sides (`export-page.test.tsx:235` and `:245`). See the inline thread.
- **export-presets.md "not merged yet" wording:** still applies; it will be answered in its inline thread with the commit that fixes it.
